purpose: Canonical map tracing identity, freshness, and restart domains from the Dell streaming SUT through arena facts-only projection, the cra-01 NO_ACTION runtime, evidence retention, and the soak oracle

boundaries.canonical_scope: Current repository structure, contracts, responsibilities, and failure domains; excludes current live-environment values.
excluded_current_values: PID, Pod UID, container ID, boot ID, sequence and sample count
live health, restart count and gate verdict

hosts.role: stream_v3 production runtime SUT and signed read-only observation source
hosts.authority: stream runtime ownership, bounded local effect fence; no CRA policy authority

hosts.role: Monitoring facts, Dell packet relay and signed arena observation
hosts.authority: facts and transport only; no recovery authorization

hosts.role: central policy, NO_ACTION runtime, durable intent truth and soak
hosts.authority: central authority; command delivery remains disabled in this profile

layers.label: Dell to arena to CRA Monitoring evidence
Committed history and deterministic soak evaluation

nodes.label: Dell target and transport observation publisher
Dell signed resilient host and service status
Arena signed resilient status with Dell upstream
Dell signed latest packet and append-only history
arena raw OAuth platform producer (stream_v3 external source)
Arena signed latest/history and relayed Dell latest/history
CRA Dell and arena recovery packet puller
CRA latest packets and three untrusted signed history archives
Raw-prefix full replay and bounded source-time/visibility logical reconstruction
Saved formal gate for the committed prefix
O(1) freshness watchdog plus saved-gate binding
Signed resilient host-status history, gate and watchdog

edges.evidence: host contract, boot identity and Kubernetes API state

edges.relationship: Deployment selects the running stream Pod

edges.relationship: Pod status binds the stream-engine container incarnation
edges.evidence: container name, container ID, readiness and restartCount

edges.relationship: container init/runtime process is the child lifecycle owner
edges.evidence: container identity, owner PID and owner start ticks

edges.relationship: owner has exactly one managed production FFmpeg direct child
edges.evidence: parent PID, process start ticks, cmdline, FFmpeg generation and target identity

edges.relationship: owner registry identifies bounded auxiliary child churn separately from FFmpeg
edges.evidence: pre-prune registry snapshot, owner identity, child start ticks and exit proof

edges.relationship: owner publishes the only process-aware recovery evidence snapshot
edges.evidence: runtime recovery evidence v3 including lifecycle, activation and effect safety

edges.relationship: Dell publisher records boot identity, service incarnations and bounded component state
edges.evidence: signed resilient host status whose component identity digests bind systemd InvocationID/NRestarts and source lineage

edges.relationship: read-only target and socket transport observation
edges.evidence: target snapshot, bytes_acked, network and platform-facing transport measurements

edges.relationship: server serves the signed publisher output without granting write authority
edges.evidence: signed Dell observation bundle

edges.relationship: Dell GET-only server exposes the immutable signed resilient status
edges.evidence: original Dell resilient-status bytes

edges.relationship: bounded GET-only mTLS pull
edges.evidence: original signed Dell observation plus pull status

edges.relationship: Arena pulls Dell signed resilient status through bounded GET-only mTLS
edges.evidence: byte-preserved Dell resilient status, admission state, pull status and recovery events

edges.relationship: live adapter joins Dell observation with read-only Monitoring facts
edges.evidence: CRA fact bundle and target snapshot

edges.relationship: producer validates, sequences and signs the facts-only projection
edges.evidence: signed Monitoring evidence projection

edges.relationship: Arena publisher records its boot identity and observation-pipeline service incarnations
edges.evidence: signed arena resilient status with service InvocationID and NRestarts

edges.relationship: Arena verifies and embeds the complete Dell signed status as upstream_status
edges.evidence: Dell payload and pull binding preserved inside the signed arena status

edges.relationship: Arena resilient status binds current adapter and projection service status
edges.evidence: pipeline status files and systemd service components

edges.relationship: server exposes only the signed projection over mTLS
edges.evidence: signed Monitoring evidence projection

edges.relationship: Arena GET-only server exposes the signed arena status and nested Dell status
edges.evidence: original arena resilient-status bytes including Dell upstream_status

edges.relationship: bounded GET-only mTLS pull with pinned source identity
edges.evidence: original signed Monitoring projection and pull status

edges.evidence: episode identity, state, classification, stall and recovery clocks, original and replacement target digests

edges.relationship: Dell observer validates the owner export and binds it into signed host facts
edges.evidence: owner lifecycle, activation, effect safety, target and transport facts

edges.evidence: unchanged Dell latest packet and sequenced history pages

edges.evidence: unchanged Dell latest/history packets and role-local pull status

edges.evidence: arena network, platform and control-path facts

edges.evidence: raw OAuth platform source file and source hash

edges.relationship: collector admits exactly the pinned Dell, arena and CRA packet identities
edges.evidence: three independently signed role packets and per-role input errors

edges.relationship: collector appends one hash-chained sample
edges.evidence: samples.jsonl sample frame

edges.relationship: collector atomically commits the exact JSONL prefix head
edges.evidence: state.json sample count, last hash and verified byte count

edges.relationship: oracle replays every frame in the pinned committed prefix
edges.evidence: full history, sample chain, gaps, blockers, owner counts and recovery episodes

edges.relationship: formal oracle verifies three complete signed archives for every raw interval, then orders source transitions by signed time and per-role sequence within a bounded visibility interval; equal virtual milliseconds use logical steps

edges.relationship: state pins the byte length and terminal sample identity replayed by the oracle
edges.evidence: committed-prefix head

edges.relationship: formal gate atomically saves the verdict for the exact evaluated prefix
edges.evidence: gate.json with prefix identity, Harness classification and formal status

edges.relationship: watchdog checks current committed head freshness without replacing formal replay
edges.evidence: state head, live recovery checkpoint and current time

edges.relationship: watchdog binds the saved formal gate to the current committed prefix
edges.evidence: formal gate prefix identity and evaluation age

edges.relationship: CRA host owns the central NO_ACTION runtime incarnation
edges.evidence: host contract, boot identity and runtime systemd InvocationID

edges.relationship: NO_ACTION runtime consumes only a validated local projection
edges.evidence: pinned signed projection and pull status

edges.relationship: runtime persists only NO_ACTION observation and durable intent state
edges.evidence: Central DB integrity and action-related table inventory

edges.relationship: NO_ACTION profile exposes no command-delivery capability
edges.evidence: command_delivery_enabled=false and control_capability_count=0

edges.relationship: no command may cross from CRA to the Dell effect fence in NO_ACTION
edges.evidence: zero command delivery and zero additional physical effect

restart_domains.label: Dell host reboot
identity_changes: process and systemd invocation identities below the host
observation_sources: Dell signed resilient host status host_boot_id
Dell systemd show InvocationID,NRestarts for scoped services
new_epoch_when: host_boot_id changes
observer boot-bound state rejects the new boot

restart_domains.label: Arena host reboot
identity_changes: all arena process and systemd invocation identities
observation_sources: arena signed resilient host status host_boot_id
arena systemd show InvocationID,NRestarts for scoped services
new_epoch_when: host_boot_id changes
arena producer boot-bound state rejects the new boot

restart_domains.label: CRA host reboot
identity_changes: CRA runtime, puller, collector, gate and watchdog invocation identities
observation_sources: cra-01 systemd show InvocationID,NRestarts for scoped services
new_epoch_when: host_boot_id changes
CRA observer or persisted state cannot bind the new boot

restart_domains.label: stream_v3 Pod replacement
observation_sources: Dell Kubernetes API Pod UID and ownerReferences
Dell signed resilient status target identity digest
new_epoch_when: source commit, release, config or admitted identity changes
the replacement creates an unobservable history gap

restart_domains.label: stream-engine container restart
restart_domains.event: container_id or restart_count changes without a host reboot
new_epoch_when: admitted source identity or config changes
history cannot prove the transition

restart_domains.label: owner process incarnation change
must_preserve: container identity unless container also restarted
observation_sources: Dell owner export owner_pid and owner_start_ticks
new_epoch_when: owner transition is missing from signed history
runtime release or source changes

restart_domains.label: production FFmpeg respawn
must_preserve: effect conservation unless a separately authorized effect exists
observation_sources: Dell owner export ffmpeg_pid, child_pid, child_start_ticks and ffmpeg_generation
new_epoch_when: recovery episode or effect attribution is unobservable
source identity changes

restart_domains.label: registered auxiliary child churn
restart_domains.event: registered non-FFmpeg child exits, is reaped or is replaced
observation_sources: test-owned process evidence for bounded churn
new_epoch_when: identity cannot be re-proven and raw owner evidence remains unverified

restart_domains.label: Dell high-cadence RTMPS collector restart
restart_domains.event: collector systemd InvocationID changes or its process restarts
must_preserve: detector state and latest durable episode
new_epoch_when: detector state or append-only history is lost or forked
release, epoch, config, host boot, Pod or container identity changes without an explicit transition

restart_domains.label: Dell observer or serving process restart
restart_domains.event: systemd InvocationID changes or a timer invocation fails
must_preserve: signed pending packet and append-only history
observation_sources: Dell recovery packet producer_id and sequence
new_epoch_when: observer producer state is lost or reset
release, source, key, config or host boot identity changes

restart_domains.label: Arena Monitoring, recovery observer or relay restart
restart_domains.event: a component InvocationID changes or timer invocation fails
must_preserve: arena signed history and relayed Dell signed history
observation_sources: arena projection and recovery producer sequence
new_epoch_when: producer sequence state is lost or reset
release, source, key, config or host boot identity changes
required signed history cannot be reconstructed within the bounded archive/selection limits

restart_domains.label: CRA pull or local observer restart
restart_domains.event: a puller or observer InvocationID changes or timer invocation fails
must_preserve: CRA observer producer sequence and signed pending packet
observation_sources: CRA recovery observer producer_id and sequence
new_epoch_when: observer producer state is lost or reset
release, source, key, config or host boot identity changes
required signed history cannot be reconstructed within the bounded archive/selection limits

restart_domains.label: CRA NO_ACTION runtime restart
observation_sources: cra-01 raw systemctl show cra-runtime-no-action InvocationID,NRestarts
CRA runtime status release_id and host_boot_id
CRA signed recovery observer runtime facts
new_epoch_when: release, source, config or host boot identity changes
runtime restart evidence is missing or safety cannot be re-proven

restart_domains.label: collector invocation failure or schedule interruption
restart_domains.event: oneshot invocation fails, clock regresses or inter-sample gap increases
observation_sources: cra-01 raw systemctl show recovery-soak collector service/timer
new_epoch_when: state or evidence history is lost or forked
config or admitted source identity changes

restart_domains.label: gate or watchdog evaluation process restart
restart_domains.event: read-only evaluation invocation changes or fails
observation_sources: cra-01 raw systemctl show recovery-soak gate/watchdog service/timer
saved gate evaluated_at and prefix identity
new_epoch_when: evaluation reveals source/config drift or a history fork; evaluation-process restart alone is not sufficient

restart_domains.label: resilient host-status collector, gate or watchdog restart
restart_domains.event: collector, gate or watchdog InvocationID changes, a timer fails, or inter-sample gap increases
must_preserve: arena and Dell signed payload identity
observation_sources: cra-01 raw systemctl show resilient-status collector/gate/watchdog service/timer
new_epoch_when: evidence or state is lost or forked
release, key, admitted source or config changes
a gap exceeds the formal limit

restart_domains.label: unexpected command delivery or physical effect
restart_domains.event: command delivery becomes enabled or an additional physical attempt/effect is observed
observation_sources: CRA runtime status command_delivery_enabled and control_capability_count
CRA Central DB five action-related table counts
Dell owner effect evidence physical_attempt_count and physical_effect_outcome
new_epoch_when: only after the cause is corrected, a replacement release is admitted and prior failure history is preserved

failure_modes.label: Ordering races between owner, FFmpeg, and helper child lifecycles
failure_modes.trigger: Collector polling overlaps child exit, unreaped children, empty cmdline, PID reuse, or successor observations

failure_modes.label: RTMPS session ACK stall and FFmpeg replacement while general WAN remains UP
failure_modes.trigger: Within the same runtime, bytes_acked stops advancing while send pressure remains, followed by persistence confirmation or FFmpeg generation replacement

failure_modes.label: Abrupt FFmpeg session loss without observable flat ACK, followed by child replacement within the same runtime
failure_modes.trigger: The last valid target is followed by SOURCE_GENERATION_INVALID or SOURCE_NOT_RATE_ELIGIBLE, then FFmpeg identity changes within 45 seconds in the same parent runtime

failure_modes.label: Dell FULL_WAN outage and recovery
failure_modes.trigger: Record failure of all independent anchors as a durable episode, then confirm ACK progress and platform recovery for the same stream

failure_modes.label: Failure or missing observations from the stream_v3 OAuth upstream source
failure_modes.trigger: OAuth probe evidence is unavailable because liveBroadcasts/list or liveStreams/list fetches fail, retries are exhausted, or authentication/transport fails

failure_modes.label: Missing or stale monitoring, signed sources, or cross-host transport
failure_modes.trigger: Source, signature, freshness, sequence, mTLS relay, or the host-status chain fails validation

failure_modes.label: Inconsistency between append-only history, state, full replay, and saved gates
failure_modes.trigger: Mismatch in sample chain, committed prefix, config, clock, saved gate/watchdog binding, post-start capacity extrapolation, or source time, visibility window, and logical order of delayed signed packets

failure_modes.label: Safety violation in NO_ACTION, the SQLite action ledger, or the delivery/effect fence
failure_modes.trigger: Delivery is enabled, any of the five action tables grows, effect attempts increase, or database integrity cannot be proven

failure_modes.label: Old observation unit returns at boot or the new unit was not enabled
failure_modes.trigger: Cutover completes while the old generation remains enabled or the new generation is not both active and enabled
